about: T1.36's acceptance tests for sdm-contract-run --pre-given-specs (a case written before contract 23, its describe_source spec in contract 22's shape, read and rewritten as Given), written by the independent test author before the implementation, in rust/crates/sdm-testkit/tests/t136_pre_given_specs.rs. 'authored' lists the checks that failed when they were written (the flag was unknown, the binary printed its usage); 'preflight-without-flag' passed then and is not listed. Each check in 'pending' must still fail (strict); the implementer takes a check out of 'pending' once it passes, and changes nothing else: 'pending' stays within 'authored', which is the test author's.
